how: We read the website of every Miami wedding florist listed on Lazo (302 listings, 205 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops and their per-neighborhood pages, a retail home-goods collective with a floral counter, and a studio whose site was too thin to describe. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What holds up in Miami's heat and humidity for an outdoor ceremony, and what wilts? Ask what you should avoid for your month.
Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
Can I see a full wedding's florals at a budget like mine, not just a bouquet photo?

picks.name: Bayfront Floral & Event Design
picks.blurb: Serving South Florida since 1983, Bayfront Floral & Event Design was founded by Rick and Stacy and is trusted by hotels and venues for wedding and event florals. Luxury wedding flowers, installations and event decor from a Fort Lauderdale studio.

picks.name: The Bride Candy
picks.blurb: Christopher Plaza calls flowers his love language and runs The Bride Candy as a Miami floral design studio specializing in vintage, tropical, moody and romantic wedding flowers, including secret-garden-inspired weddings full of color.

picks.name: Fleur de Marsca
picks.blurb: A boutique floral atelier specializing in romantic luxury weddings and events, with services tailored from style boards to custom color palettes. Fleur de Marsca is South Florida based and also takes bridal and baby showers.

picks.name: RusticMeetsChic
picks.blurb: Rebecca grew up in Ecuador in a family of three generations of florists and leads Rustic Meets Chic, a wedding floral design and event styling studio for ceremonies, receptions and bridal parties, from timeless romance to bold modern designs.

picks.name: Suhaag Garden Inc
picks.blurb: South Asian wedding decor from a team that counts over 700 luxury events and works from creative consultations, floor plans and 3D models so clients see the design before the day. Florals, stage backdrops and lighting, based in Florida and traveling across the U.S.

picks.name: Events by Nicky
picks.blurb: A floral and wedding design studio run by Nicky, a floral designer and event planner with 10 years of experience. She says working with kind, genuine couples is what drives her and that her strength is bringing their vision to life.

picks.name: Gerilyn Gianna Event and Floral Design
picks.blurb: Born in the Philippines, raised in Italy and educated in the United States, Gerilyn Gianna fell for weddings watching brides outside a church in Italy. Her Palm Beach studio does flowers, decor, lighting, draping and full design transformations.

picks.name: Southern Floral Company
picks.blurb: A Palm Beach County wedding florist that started from home, arranging flowers for family and friends, and says it treats every wedding as if it were one of its own children's. Southern Floral Company shows custom weddings, a gallery and testimonials on the site.

picks.name: Ellie's Garden Design Studio
picks.blurb: Ellie's signature aesthetic is inspired by nature and the harmonious ways of wild gardens, balancing natural and organic with elegant and classic. Her West Palm Beach studio designs florals custom to each client's style, working the pieces out together.

picks.name: A Blooming Touch
picks.blurb: Fifteen years of floral and event design for private and corporate events, with linens, charger plates, furniture, draping and uplighting available from the same Miami company. A Blooming Touch is one stop if you want the flowers and the tabletop handled together.

picks.name: Natinel Flower Design, wedding specialist
picks.blurb: A Miami flower studio focused on detail-oriented, affordable service, with linens, chairs, tables and wedding accessories in the same Doral showroom. Natinel does ceremony decor including beach ceremonies, huppahs and arches.

picks.name: Florenzza Flowers & Events
picks.blurb: Florenzza Flowers & Events combines floral design with wedding planning out of Doral, beginning with a one-on-one consultation about your love story and theme. For couples who want the florist and the planner to be the same people.
